summary: This paper presents four original structural theorems resolving open problems in discrete Wigner negativity and magic resource theory introduced by Sharma et al. (2026). The authors establish: (1) a Universal Level-m Hankel-SOS Quantitative Negativity Bound converting negative Hankel witnesses into certified lower bounds and closing ququint blind zones via deterministic Schur-complement witnesses; (2) an Unconditional Positive-Part Signed-Decomposition Saturation Inequality with exact extremal characterization; (3) an Infinite-Family Odd-Dimension (H1, B4)-Blind-Spot Separation Theorem; and (4) a Higher-Even-Moment Multiplicative Mana Family demonstrating the sharp reverse-monotonicity and unique optimality of k = 2. All core algebraic theorems are formally verified in Lean 4.36.0 (0 sorry) and paired with an exact-Q verification suite.
strengths: Comprehensive resolution of three prominent open problems in discrete Wigner negativity hierarchies.

weaknesses: The odd-dimension quasiprobability separation family x^(D) is provably unphysical for odd primes D >= 3 (though physical separation is successfully demonstrated using ququint density matrices).
Scope is strictly focused on discrete Wigner functions and stabilizer resource theory, leaving continuous-variable generalizations for future work.
